resources.string: People are created in a note: tap + and use Add person.
Projects are created in a note: tap + and use Add project.
This file is not a Doro Organizer backup.
This backup was made by a newer version of Doro Organizer. Update the app, then try again.
This backup does not match this version of Doro Organizer.
This backup is damaged or incomplete.
I understand this cannot be recovered
This password contains characters that cannot be used.
Too many attempts. Try again in %1$s.
You will enter this password when the app starts, unless fingerprint unlock is on. It cannot be recovered: if you forget it and cannot use your fingerprint, the only way back in is to erase all data.
Choose a new startup password. It replaces the old one; your notes stay as they are. After you confirm, touch the fingerprint sensor.
Doro Organizer is protected by a startup password.
Your regular password check: enter it so you keep remembering it.
The fingerprints on this phone changed, so your password is needed.
The password could not be checked. Try again.

This phone\'s secure storage failed, so your password cannot open the app right now. Your fingerprint still can: as soon as fingerprint unlock works again, \"Use fingerprint\" appears here. If it does not come back, a backup is the way back: choose \"Forgot password?\", erase all data, then restore the backup from Settings.
Fingerprint unlock did not work. Try again or use your password.
You can set a new startup password with your fingerprint. Your notes stay as they are.
Set a new password with your fingerprint
If you cannot use your fingerprint, erase all data and start over. Afterwards you can restore a backup from Settings; an encrypted backup needs the password it was made with.
Your password was accepted, but the database could not be opened. Enter it again to try again.

The password cannot be recovered or reset, and without it the data in this app cannot be opened.\n\nYou can erase all data and start over. Afterwards you can restore a backup from Settings; an encrypted backup needs the password it was made with.
Erase all data and start over
All notes, people and projects, the encryption key and the security settings will be deleted from this device. This cannot be undone.
The database could not be opened
Something prevented opening your data, for example full storage, or the app was replaced by an older version. Your data was not changed. Free up space or install the latest version, then try again.
Keep the app open until this finishes.
Doro Organizer cannot read its database. The file is kept until you choose what to do: restore a backup, or start fresh with an empty database.

The key that protects your data could not be read from this device\'s secure storage. This can happen after a system update or a security reset. Without the key the data cannot be opened. Restore a backup, or start fresh with an empty database.

The current database and everything in it will be deleted from this device, and the app will start empty and unencrypted. This cannot be undone. If you have a backup, choose Restore from backup instead.
Confirm that you understand the password cannot be recovered.
Not enough free storage, so nothing was changed. Free up some space and try again.
The file could not be read or written. Try again, or choose another location.
The encryption key could not be accessed, so nothing was changed. Try again later.
Authentication failed. The setting was not changed.
Another operation is still running. Try again when it has finished.
Your data is not available right now. Try again.

The app could not confirm whether this change was applied, so it reloaded your data. Check that your notes are as you expect. If the app asks for a password after a password change, try the new password first, then the old one.
Something went wrong. Your data was not changed.
